annotations.title: Flood risk for a Dutch address (paid)

description: Use when the user asks if a Dutch address can flood: annual flood probability (any water, over 20, 50 and 200 cm) from Rijkswaterstaat LIWO, 2050 and 2100 climate scenarios, worst-case water depth and ground height vs sea level (AHN). Input: postcode + house number. Costs 0.004 USDC via x402, or 2 credits of a Factline API key.

q.description: Alternative to postcode: free-text address, e.g. 'Visschersplein 1 Utrecht'
